# Aloya

> Cyprus's calmest way to ride the bus — live ETAs, smart routing, and bespoke editorial design built for Nicosia, Limassol, Larnaca, Paphos, and the intercity network.

Aloya is a mobile-first transit companion for Cyprus. It fuses official GTFS data (Nicosia urban + Cyprus intercity) with live vehicle positions, Google Routes for walking guidance, and crowdsourced rider signals to give riders trustworthy ETAs and door-to-door journeys.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Plan a journey, live network pulse at a glance
- [Network pulse](/pulse): Live map of every bus moving in Cyprus right now
- [Plan trips](/trips): Door-to-door multi-leg journey planner
- [Saved places](/saved): Pinned stops, home, work, favourites
- [Motion bus card](/wallet): Top-up balance, recent taps, card status
- [Privacy](/privacy): What we store, what we don't, how rider data is handled
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of use
